title: Hybris stock stores
subtitle: The stores whose stock OMS sends to the website (Hybris), and how each one's sync is doing.

access.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the Hybris stock view grant. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so this screen stays closed. Try again in a moment.

reason.label: Reason
reason.hint: Required. It is kept with the change.

off.title: The Hybris stock sync is off
off.body: Nothing is sent to Hybris. Marking stores and editing materials still takes effect once it is switched on.

shadow.title: Shadow mode
shadow.body: Files are written to a shadow path that Hybris does not import, so the website does not change.

live.title: Live
live.body: Files are delivered to Hybris's hot folder. Hybris imports them on its own schedule.

unknown.title: Sync mode unknown
unknown.body: The rail's mode could not be read. Do not assume it is live.

results.failedTitle: The stores could not be loaded
results.viewOnly: View only: marking stores and push now need the Hybris stock manage grant.

cause.deltaBehind: No successful delta for more than two intervals.

mark.title: Mark as a Hybris stock store
mark.note: <store>{{store}}</store> starts sending its stock to Hybris. Its first push is a full of every enabled material, before any delta.
mark.doneDetail: Store {{store}} is a Hybris stock store. A full is on its way.

unmark.title: Unmark this Hybris stock store
unmark.note: OMS stops sending the stock of <store>{{store}}</store>. Nothing is sent to Hybris: it keeps the stock it was last sent, and taking the store off the website is Hybris's own decision.
unmark.doneDetail: Store {{store}} no longer sends its stock to Hybris.

history.failed: The history could not be loaded
history.empty: This store has never been marked.
